say:1:1123513001:1.text: How am I doing?! Hmph! My voice is hoarse from yelling every day! Those bears are only good at eating! They can't pick up anything I've taught them!
say:1:1123513001:1.source_cn: 最近怎么样？哼，每天都被气的半死。\n那群笨熊就知道吃...

say:2:1123513002:1.text: And you... I thought I would never see you again since you only visited because Kruger asked you to.
say:2:1123513002:1.source_cn: 还有你，我以为你当初探望我是受到委托而已，不会再来看我了。
say:2:1123513002:1.male: And you... I thought I would never see you again since you only visited because Kruger asked you to.
say:2:1123513002:1.female: And you... I thought I would never see you again since you only visited because Kruger asked you to.

say:3:1123513003:1.text: However, I do appreciate your kindness. Don't forget to drop by every now and then.
say:3:1123513003:1.source_cn: 算你有点心吧，记得时不时来黑嚎看看。
say:3:1123513003:1.male: However, I do appreciate your kindness. Don't forget to drop by every now and then.
say:3:1123513003:1.female: However, I do appreciate your kindness. Don't forget to drop by every now and then.
